name: platform
label: Platform name
help_text: Social media platform (e.g. Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), YouTube).

name: content_type
label: Content type
help_text: Format label shown below the platform name (e.g. Static image (portrait), Reel / Story, Thumbnail).

name: dimensions
label: Dimensions
help_text: Width × height in pixels. No spaces around the × symbol (e.g. 1080×1350).

name: shape_class
label: Shape class
help_text: Controls the CSS shape of the visual preview. Match to the aspect ratio.
